pages.text: Burn sulfur (or gunpowder) in oxygen for $(fluid)Sulfur Dioxide$(). Over vanadium, 2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃ - exothermic again, so the equilibrium falls back as it heats, but the $(item)Vanadium Bed$() only lights off near 670 K.

The $(item)Contact Process Tower$() cools the gas between its three beds. Set the bed temperature and the oxygen excess; a pass must convert 95%. The sulfur trioxide is absorbed into $(fluid)Sulfuric Acid$(). Above 873 K the bed sinters. Iron ore carries a little vanadium: eight raw iron make a bed.
